# Public original-source controls

Copied from the Round 14 handoff's `附件/技能原型/PhysicsGuard`: `first/` contains the original shower/heated-tank seeds, `second/` the 19 fresh-seed inputs, and `third/` the 30 third-batch controls. The native regression test states each independently described source fault; third-batch TRUTH takes precedence over the v1 prototype's known range and grouping misreads. Known numeric-role swaps, number words and midnight spans are labelled as not caught. These synthetic public fixtures do not establish coverage of general natural-language physics questions.
